body.title: Coverage eligibility and the judge context
body.summary: assembleCodeReviewGrounding (src/workflow/code-review/grounding.ts:74-104) sets coverageEligible (function/method/class in a non-test file); buildDiffSymbols rows (:296-310) are not eligible; add JudgeContext { groundingMode } passed by the runner to every judge slot (src/workflow/code-review/runner.ts:69-71, :193) from its options; types in src/workflow/code-review/types.ts.
acceptanceChecks: Sections, documents, config, types, interfaces and every test-file entity are not eligible; functions, methods and classes in source files are.
Every judge slot receives the run's groundingMode; the daemon diff path reaches judges as 'degraded'.
The grounding handed to the adherence, conventions and quality judges still holds every changed symbol, eligible and ineligible alike.
